findings.title: Cache is not checked again after taking the write lock.
findings.body: If several requests arrive while the cache is empty (for example right after startup), they all see `ret == nil`. Each one then waits for the write lock and reloads the manifest from disk, one after another, even though the first one already filled the cache. Fix: after `Lock()`, check again with `if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { return entryPointAssetsCache, nil }` before loading the assets.
